description: This PHP class 'ApplyLeaveController' extends 'AbstractVueController' and manages the logic for applying leave in the OrangeHRM system. It retrieves and prepares work schedule information for the leave application component, utilizing traits for authentication, date/time helpers, and work schedule services.

classes.name: ApplyLeaveController
classes.description: Controller handling leave application page, preparing work shift info for the leave application Vue component.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares data required for rendering the leave application component, particularly the work shift times.
